    children:
    - type: sequence
      children:
      - type: move_to_keypoint

  type: sequence
  children:
  - type: retry
    params:
      max_attempts: 2
    children:
    - type: sequence
      children:
      - type: move_to_keypoint
        params:
          keypoint_label: bowl
          offset_z: 0
      - type: grasp
        params:
          force: 60
          target_width: 0.02
      - type: verify_grasp
        params: {}
  - type: move_relative
    params:
      dz: 0.2
  - type: fallback
    children:
    - type: sequence
      children:
      - type: move_to_keypoint
        params:
          keypoint_label: plate
          offset_z: 0.04
      - type: release
        params:
          tilt_angle: 0
      - type: verify_placed
        params:
          obj: bowl
          container: plate
          relation: 'on'
    - type: sequence
      children:
      - type: search_keypoint
        params:
          keypoint_label: bowl
      - type: move_to_keypoint
        params:
          keypoint_label: bowl
          offset_z: 0
      - type: grasp
        params:
          force: 60
          target_width: 0.02
      - type: move_to_keypoint
        params:
          keypoint_label: plate
          offset_z: 0.04
      - type: release
        params:
          tilt_angle: 0
